description.narrative: The project aims to promote inclusive growth and economic diversification by supporting the development of niche and high-value agribusiness value chains, promoting firms export capacity and contributing to improving the business environment.

condition.narrative: Consistent with the Article III of the SBAA [or the Supplemental Provisions to the Project Document], the responsibility for the safety and security of the Implementing Partner and its personnel and property, and of UNDP’s property in the Implementing Partner’s custody, rests with the Implementing Partner. To this end, the Implementing Partner shall: a) put in place an appropriate security plan and maintain the security plan, taking into account the security situation in the country where the project is being carried; b) assume all risks and liabilities related to the Implementing Partner’s security, and the full implementation of the security plan.

Social and environmental sustainability will be enhanced through application of the UNDP Social and Environmental Standards (http://www.undp.org/ses) and related Accountability Mechanism (http://www.undp.org/secu-srm).

Based on STP´s COVID-19 livelihood and recovery priorities and the project´s Theory of Change, the main objective is to boost active participation in the embryonic agribusiness sector in Sao Tome and Principe and address the competitiveness in the countries business operating climate. The project will achieve this objective by delivering outputs in four key areas.

1) 26 Agribusiness business owners trained in business management, trade, 2) 26 Businesses with a well-established business plan, enabling access to finance and technology, with a strong focus on women-owned businesses 3) 26 SMEs operating in the agribusiness sector empowered to develop products that respond to markets and buyers needs (especially export markets) 4) 16 Companies operating in the agribusiness sector certified organic 5) 26 Business owners organized in networks, for the search of potential interested parties in the agricultural products produced in STP, subject to obtaining a certain level of quality and standards required by the final markets. ; 6) Decrease in obstacles to trade in terms of governance: Foreign Trade Portal Created and Operational, Arbitration Centre Rehabilitated and Operational 7) More predictable business operating environment, with more robust legal and regulatory frameworks, a reduction in red tape to improve the ease of doing business, and encourage investors to choose STP: Rehabilitated and Operational Arbitration Centre
